correctness.rationale: Let C=[[2,1],[1,1]], C′=[[1,−1],[−1,2]], W_i=span(e_i), v_i=1 in R². Both controllers are positive definite, inverses with C*C′=I. Since P1+P2=I, the total quadratic controlled-form sum is exactly ||f||² for every f; this satisfies the displayed Definition 3.1 with A=B=1. Yet C*P1C′=[[2,−2],[1,−1]] is not selfadjoint and <A1e2,e2>=−1, so no positive square root exists and its squared-norm identity would demand a negative norm square. Conversely local positivity allows bounded positive roots and the coefficient norm equality. Exact rational 2×2 matrix arithmetic independently reproduced; no extrapolation.
